description: Sand Dam Suitability Assessment, A Case of the Lower Awash Basin, Ethiopia is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley Data. Water security is a crucial issue in arid and semi-arid regions like the Lower Awash Basin, Ethiopia, where increasing population and economic development put pressure on limited water resources. This study evaluates the suitability of sand dam sites using a multi-criteria evaluation approach combined with geospatial techniques. Coverage: Ethiopia. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley Data. Its tags are Water Supply, Watershed Management, Arid Region, Water Security. The repository dates the deposit 2025; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support dam, reservoir and flood defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
